description: Free inspection of supplied x402 v1/v2 payment terms against the SDK schema and optional network, asset, recipient and atomic budget constraints. Exact EVM profile checks only. No wallet connection, external fetch, signature verification or settlement. Other profiles are explicitly untested.

challenge.description: Decoded PaymentRequired object from HTTP or MCP structuredContent. No signed payment or credentials.

expected.description: Optional exact terms. An atomic budget requires network and asset.

name: check_payment_terms
title: Inspect x402 payment terms without making a payment
